crossRefs.note: “Now rise up, and cross over the brook Zered.” We went over the brook Zered.
The days in which we came from Kadesh Barnea until we had come over the brook Zered were thirty-eight years: until all…

people.name: Zered
people.line: A brook marking the end of Israel's wilderness wanderings

translations.web: From there they traveled, and encamped in the valley of Zered.
translations.bsb: From there they set out and camped in the Valley of Zered.
translations.kjv: From thence they removed, and pitched in the valley of Zared.
translations.asv: From thence they journeyed, and encamped in the valley of Zered.
